notFoundBody: This contest doesn’t exist, or isn’t yours.
loadError: The contest couldn’t be loaded. Please try again.
closeError: The contest couldn’t be closed. Please try again.
revealError: The contest couldn’t be revealed. Please try again.
driveNote: Closing can’t be reopened, and revealing can’t be undone — each asks you to confirm.
revealedNote: The results are out — participants can see them.
noActivity: Nothing has happened to this contest yet.
activityFailed: The recent activity couldn’t be loaded.
dangerBody: Deleting takes the contest, its votes and its log away for everyone.

close.title: Close voting?
close.body: No more votes can be sent after this, and it can’t be reopened.

reveal.title: Reveal the results?
reveal.body: The winners become visible to everyone. This can’t be undone.
